reason: Four solid sources (Concacaf, beIN Sports, OneFootball, Wikipedia) confirm a 2026 Ballon d'Or women's award at the London ceremony on 26 Oct 2026. Official ballondor.com and francefootball.fr returned 403 and could not be opened, so the award is confirmed by a confederation page and press, not the award body. Goal totals conflict and are recorded in notes.

sources.title: Charlyn Corral honored as 2026 Women's Striker of the Year
Charlyn Corral Makes History as First Mexican Honored at the Ballon d'Or
Historic! Charlyn Corral wins Gerd Müller Trophy, Mexico tops Ballon d'Or

nationality.note: Concacaf describes her as a Mexican player and key member of the Mexico Women's National Team.

gapNote: Coverage of the 2026 award is consistent that she was the first Mexican honoured, but goal totals differ: Concacaf and OneFootball give 43 goals and 11 assists in 46 matches for 2025-26, while beIN gives 57 goals in calendar 2025 (50 for Pachuca, 7 for Mexico). Birth date and birthplace are only stated in Wikipedia (11 Sep 1991, Acolman) and an unopened ESPN Deportes note (Ecatepec), so they are left null. The official Ballon d'Or pages could not be checked. Top results are a mix of stats pages and press, so an explainer that sets the award in her career and sorts out the goal totals fills a gap.
